input_constraints.gray_bbox: complete rectangular color-5 field with a zero margin
input_constraints.interaction: the two clipped color rectangles overlap
input_constraints.markers: two non-gray colors, four corner markers per joint bbox
input_constraints.parameter_dependency: none; identical inputs are valid for both settings
